_comment: Public boundary allowlist for generated site data (issue officeadmin-books#3963).
modules-docs.json may only contain the modules listed here and only the
fields listed under module_fields. Free-form text (titles, purposes,
MODULE.md prose) is NEVER taken from the private sources: every public
module carries a curated, public-safe 'description' defined right here,
which the generator prefers over any internal text. Internal-only module
topics (secrets, agents, sync, launchd, jobs, AI engine bridges, personal
modules, the macOS automation bridge, ...) stay out of the public repo.
system-map.json / system-map.v2.json (the internal atlas) are not
published at all and must stay untracked (see test-public-boundary.py).
bin/generate-docs.py and scripts/test-public-boundary.py both read this
file; edit here, never in the code, to change the boundary.

modules.description: The orchestrator. Scans inbound mail, texts and voicemail, resolves who is who, drafts replies and routes everything to the right lane.
Interactive drafting brain. Researches context across channels and drafts messages; never sends.
Schedules messages and follow-ups to go out at the right time.
Unified dossier CLI. One lookup that fans out across every knowledge source in under a second.
Long-term knowledge graph built from sessions, notes and conversations.
Resolves any name, slug, email or phone to one canonical entity.
Memory hydration across Apple Notes and the knowledge graph.
Apple Contacts integration: search and maintain canonical contact records.
Search across AI sessions, conversations and messages.
Tracks every in-flight commitment between you and someone else: open, blocked, done, dead.
Voice memos and calls become searchable transcripts with speaker identification.
Google integrations: Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Sheets, Docs and Tasks behind one auth layer.
Reads and sends iMessages, with real-time search.
Reads Instagram DMs within the messaging window; replies stay manual.
Message client for Apple Messages.
WhatsApp CLI and daemon for reading and answering WhatsApp chats.
QuickBooks Online integration: estimates, invoices, payments and AR aging.
Electrical estimating skill: the pricing reference behind quotes.
Apple Calendar integration: list and manage events.
Apple Notes integration across folders.
Apple Reminders integration.
Transcribes audio, video and YouTube URLs.
